short.text: Uche Nwaneri was a viable NFL starting guard who held Jacksonville's left-guard job in every game of 2013, all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and both playoff games. He was a power guard whose strengths were his anchor inside and his drive blocking, and in the 2013 preseason he identified his protection assignments correctly. He was less effective on movement blocks, and he needed steadier leverage after reading his assignment correctly.

transactions.text: Signed a five-year contract extension with Jacksonville
Traded by Jacksonville to Arizona, with Jacksonville's 2015 first-, 2015 fourth- and 2016 fifth-round picks, for Arizona's 2014 second-round pick (No. 38)
